.github/workflows/ci.yml.text:
name: ci

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  merge_group:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  # Reproducible installs; the store is restored by setup-node's pnpm cache.
  CI: 'true'

jobs:
  lint:
    name: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # Every static check `pnpm run -s verify` runs, as one command derived from the same table
      # (scripts/verify-targets.ts): biome, the generated JSON Schemas, the .gitignore guard, the
      # NUL-byte guard and the merge-conflict-marker guard. Listing them here instead was a second
      # copy of the list, and it had
      # drifted — `ignored:check` was in `verify` and in no CI job at all, so a guard that had
      # already caught two live defects gated nothing on a push. `scripts/verify.test.ts` fails
      # when a target or group in that table is not run by this workflow.
      - run: pnpm run -s verify:static

  typecheck:
    name: typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run -s verify:types

  bundle:
    name: bundle budget
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # Builds apps/web and measures the initial graph dist/index.html requests against
      # TD-013's 300 kB gzipped budget. A step of `verify` (scripts/verify-targets.ts),
      # so it cannot be added there and forgotten here.
      - run: pnpm run -s verify:bundle

  unit:
    name: unit + contract
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run -s verify:tests
      - name: upload coverage
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: coverage-unit
          path: coverage/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  ui:
    name: ui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run -s verify:ui

  web-e2e:
    name: web e2e (playwright)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # The browser binary is not in the pnpm store, so it is installed explicitly. Only
      # Chromium: the suite asserts application behaviour against a fake API and a fake SSE
      # backend, not rendering differences between engines.
      - name: install the Playwright browser
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: pnpm run -s verify:web-e2e
      - name: upload the Playwright report
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  integration:
    name: integration
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # Testcontainers reaches the runner's Docker daemon and starts one
      # PostgreSQL 18 for the whole project (test/integration/support).
      # TEST_DATABASE_URL would point the suite at an external server instead.
      - run: pnpm run -s verify:integration

  e2e:
    name: e2e-fake-claude
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # Starts whole `apps/server` instances against the same Testcontainers
      # PostgreSQL 18 the integration tier uses. technical/10 describes this
      # tier as running against `docker compose` (app + db); the compose file
      # lands with WP-22, and the app container joins it then. The fake Claude
      # runner joins with WP-12.
      - run: pnpm run -s verify:e2e

  secret-scan:
    name: secret scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: gitleaks (full history)
        run: pnpm run -s secrets:scan:ci

  # The two commit gates run on every trigger this workflow has, not on pull_request only:
  # this project pushes straight to `main`, and an `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`
  # reported `skipped` — a green tick — on every push, so neither gate ever ran. The range is
  # resolved from the event payload by scripts/commits.mjs (before..after on a push, base..head
  # on a pull request or merge group); a range it cannot determine is a failure, not a pass.
  commitlint:
    name: commitlint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Both gates walk a commit range, which a shallow clone cannot answer for.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run -s verify:commitlint

  dco:
    name: dco
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      # The check itself needs only git and node, but pnpm 12 installs before running a script
      # when node_modules is missing; the frozen install keeps that explicit and reproducible.
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: every commit carries a Signed-off-by trailer matching its author
        run: pnpm run -s verify:dco
